name: Atika bint Abd al-Muttalib
bio: Atika bint Abd al-Muttalib belonged to the Hashim clan of Mecca and was an aunt of the Prophet Muhammad. Abu Tammam selected verses in which she celebrates her people's part in the fighting at Ukaz. Al-Zirikli places her in Mecca at the time of Badr in 2 AH (624 CE) and records differing accounts of her conversion and migration to Medina.
